title: Bank Confirmation Call
scenario: A caller says they are from the company bank and asks to confirm token codes.

answers.A: Act immediately because the request sounds urgent and important.
answers.B: Use the approved company system or verified process.
answers.C: Escalate to IT, finance, HR, legal, or your manager through official channels.
answers.D: Reply to the sender asking them to confirm the request.

explanation: Bank Confirmation Call: the trap is to get access to an account, code, password, or permission. The safer move is to verify through an official or approved channel, not to act before verifying.
proTip: Bank security codes must not be shared.
